args.summary: Covered all checklist areas. The war loop was repetitive: queueing musketeers in each city every turn felt like a chore. The landmark picks chain across eras, and I found that confusing. In the RTS defence battle my only squad was overrun quickly, and the battle was not paused during the tutorial tip. Overall the game is playable but pacing feels flat in the late stretch.

args.summary: Played to turn 165 in the information age. The loop is mostly End Turn, event cards, and "needs production" prompts. Each prompt was cleared by queuing mechanized infantry, and a 36-turn build time felt slow. Every checklist area was at least looked at. Pacing gets repetitive late. The event cards and repeated production prompts were the main chores. Better auto-queue and batch handling would help.
